articles.title: IF ONLY SOMEBODY TOLD US ABOUT THE NVIDIA GPU SMUGGLING
articles.summary: BUY THE BLACK MARKET DOCUMENTARY: and our CYBERDYSTOPIA music pack:
body: Politicians are shocked to learn of thing everyone knew for a year: GPU smuggling is real and happens under their watch. Now, they clamor over the NVIDIA Jensen Huang departure (and possible return) to gain their political capital, just in time for it to have most mattered years ago. And, like rats from a sinking smuggling ship, Trump's cabinet members turn on each other as Jensen Huang becomes a scapegoat for some and an icon for others. In this video, we're talking about how it's really a shame that nobody warned us about all of this years ago, and that suddenly, out of nowhere and without any indication whatsoever, NVIDIA is question of antitrust concerns. Yes, yes. This has all just happened specifically now, and it has never been a concern before this.
